description: Java class 'GLToolbox' providing utility methods for OpenGL ES 2.0 shader compilation, program creation, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: Utility class for OpenGL ES 2.0 shader and program management, error checking, and texture parameter setup.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Creates, compiles, and returns a shader object of specified type with given source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates, links, and returns an OpenGL program using provided vertex and fragment shader sources.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws an exception if any are found.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes texture parameters for 2D textures with linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping.
